**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Parse all valid Bash fence forms**

Recognize fenced Bash blocks whose opening fence is longer than three backticks or indented by up to three spaces. The current regex accepts only a column-zero, exactly-three-backtick opener, so a task containing ````bash` followed by invalid shell syntax is skipped and can pass without a `bash-syntax` refusal. The cited threat-table closure is therefore not established by the test, which exercises only exact triple-backtick fences.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L78-L78](https://github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles/blob/6a9edf5bb76a0e2bf4cc7acded62db0dcae7c947/AGENTS.md#L78-L78)

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# @file pre-send.sh
+# @brief Check a task text's final bytes before each send, with every machine check CI or the regime applies to it.
+# @description
+#   Promoted from the orchestrator's glue (C-100, C-102, M-20261020-01, M-20261020-03). It reads the one task text it
+#   is given as data: it never edits the file and never runs its prose. Every check runs even after another refuses:
+#   the task-consistency checker, the validator's own SECRET_PATTERN (line numbers only, never the matched text),
+#   literal macOS and Linux home paths, the text's self cap (`at or under N lines` against `wc -l`), `/bin/bash -n`
+#   over every fenced bash block, and the `## Owned by <task_id>` section the text reads from a named record. Each
+#   refusal prints one named line, and a readable text's sha256 is printed last. Python runs as the pinned 3.15
+#   interpreter with -I, and uv runs with --no-config --offline. This preflight catches mistakes; it is no trust
+#   boundary against a hostile same-user process.
+# @arg $1 string The task text to check.
+# @exitcode 0 Every check passes.
+# @exitcode 1 A check refuses, or the argument is missing or unreadable.
+set -u
+root="$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/../.." && pwd)"
+py="${HOME}/.local/share/mise/installs/python/3.15.0/bin/python3"
+if [[ $# -ne 1 ]]; then
+    echo "input: refused (usage: pre-send.sh <task.md>)"
+    exit 1
+fi
+task="$1"
+if [[ ! -f ${task} || ! -r ${task} ]]; then
+    echo "input: refused (not a readable file: ${task})"
+    exit 1
+fi
+rc=0
+refuse() {
+    echo "$1: refused ($2)"
+    rc=1
+}
+
+checker="${root}/scripts/orchestrator/task-consistency-check.py"
+out="$(uv run --no-config --no-project --offline --python "${py}" --with pyyaml python -I "${checker}" --root "${root}" "${task}" 2>&1)" ||
+    refuse consistency "$(printf '%s' "${out}" | tr -s '\n ' ' ')"
+
+# SECRET_PATTERN is read from the validator's syntax tree, never imported or copied; fenced blocks are parsed, never run.
+"${py}" -I - "${root}/scripts/validate-agent-assets.py" "${task}" << 'PY' || rc=1
+import ast, re, subprocess, sys
+tree = ast.parse(open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8").read())
+calls = [n.value for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.Assign) and getattr(n.targets[0], "id", "") == "SECRET_PATTERN"]
+try:
+    pattern = re.compile(*map(ast.literal_eval, calls[0].args))
+except (IndexError, ValueError, TypeError, re.error):
+    sys.exit(print("secret-pattern: refused (no literal SECRET_PATTERN in the validator)") or 1)
+text, rc = open(sys.argv[2], encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read(), 0
+hits = [str(i) for i, line in enumerate(text.split("\n"), 1) if pattern.search(line)]
+if hits:
+    rc = print(f"secret-pattern: refused ({len(hits)} match(es) on line(s) {','.join(hits)})") or 1
+blocks = re.findall(r"^```(?:bash|sh)\n(.*?)^```", text, re.DOTALL | re.MULTILINE)

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Reject root home-directory literals**

Expand the literal-home check to cover root homes such as `~/.ssh/...` on Linux and `~/...` or `~/...` on macOS. These are home-directory literals, and the repository's authoritative `compiled_home_path_pattern` already treats them as such, but this narrower expression produces no hit and lets a task containing those local-only paths pass.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L72-L72](https://github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles/blob/6a9edf5bb76a0e2bf4cc7acded62db0dcae7c947/AGENTS.md#L72-L72)
